The 21st century Dutch tulips come in different varieties: #Bitcoin  #Ethereum #Dogecoin etc. 

Some Dutch tulip speculators made a lot of money. A lot more lost their shirts. That's how "investments" in tulips work.

https://t.co/Hi1VAKLpg0

The #ElonMusk investing rule: if an investment product swings by 10% or more based on a random tweet by Elon Musk, it's speculative, lacks fundamentals, and should be avoided at all costs.
